targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-metrics")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system_metrics")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> group()
  |> max(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 }))

from(bucket: "network-metrics")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^proto_/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
